title: Trump vows new 10% levy after Supreme Court upends global tariffs
summary: US President Donald Trump vowed Friday to charge an additional 10 percent tariff on imports into the United States after the Supreme Court struck down President Donald Trump's far-reaching "reciprocal" global tariffs.
